name: Chania · Crete
summary: Use Chania’s old harbour as a base for western Crete. Keep demanding gorge hikes and remote beaches on dedicated days with confirmed transport.
seasonNote: Beach and gorge trips depend on weather; Samaria access is seasonal and can close for safety.
arrival: Chania airport has road connections to the city; confirm a late-arrival transfer. Heraklion is a different, distant airport.
gettingAround: Walk the old town; use buses, a tour or a rental car for distant sights. Do not estimate beach drives from straight-line map distance.
cashTip: Carry EUR notes for buses and small villages; remote excursions need water and meal money.
foodTip: Try dakos, Cretan cheese, pies and seasonal vegetables; ask what is cooked that day.
buyTip: Buy olive oil, herbs and ceramics with clear origin labels; account for liquid baggage limits.
baseArea: Old town edge or Nea Chora

connections.note: Approximate airborne time; airport transfers are extra.
